item.title: Builder selected for Austin light rail
item.description: AUSTIN, Texas — The Austin agency overseeing the city’s planned light rail network has selected the construction contractor for the project. item.title: Reading & Northern announces 2026 excursions to Jim Thorpe, Pa.
item.description: PORT CLINTON, Pa. — The Reading & Northern has announced its 2026 schedule of mainline excursions to Jim Thorpe, Pa., featuring operations from Pittston and Reading, Pa. item.title: Creel: UP-NS merger ‘not a layup’ after STB rejects initial application
item.description: MIAMI — Canadian Pacific Kansas City CEO Keith Creel says the Surface Transportation Board’s rejection of the initial Union Pacific-Norfolk Southern merger application shows the $85 billion transaction is not a done deal. “I’m not drinking the merger Kool-Aid that this thing’s going to get approved. item.description: OWOSSO, Mich. — The 2025 season for Pere Marquette 2-8-4 No. 1225 was nothing short of eventful. The Berkshire-type locomotive, owned by the Steam Railroading Institute (SRI), was sidelined in late 2024, missing all of its North Pole Express excursions due to serious superheater concerns. item.title: I-80 closes, but California Zephyr gets through Sierras
item.description: TRUCKEE, Calif.— The eastbound California Zephyr arrived in Truckee today (Feb. 20) just after 1 a.m. Pacific Time, 11 hours late. But it won the battle against massive snowdrifts that had shut down parallel Interstate 80 through the Sierra Nevada mountains. item.title: FTA head Molinaro resigns
item.description: WASHINGTON — Marc Molinaro, head of the Federal Transit Administration, has resigned his position as of today (Friday, Feb. 20), reportedly to run for the New York State Assembly.
